data.income.description: Fetches income statement data from FMP API.

data.balance.description: Fetches balance sheet data from FMP API.

data.cash-flow.description: Fetches cash flow statement data from FMP API.

data.ratios.description: Fetches financial ratios and key metrics from FMP API.

data.financials.description: Fetches all three financial statements for a company.

data.enterprise-value.description: Fetches historical enterprise value from Financial Modeling Prep API.

data.profile.description: Fetches comprehensive company profile data from FMP API.

data.quote.description: Fetches the latest stock price from Financial Modeling Prep API.

data.market-cap.description: Fetches current market capitalization from FMP API.

data.shares-float.description: Fetches current float and outstanding share counts from FMP.

data.analyst-target.description: Fetches the analyst consensus target price from FMP's Stable API.

data.analyst-rating.description: Fetches the current analyst consensus from FMP's Stable API.

data.analyst-insights.description: Fetches analyst rating and target price using FMP API.

data.company-metrics.description: Fetches all key company metrics needed for equity report from FMP API.

data.technical.description: 从 FMP 获取历史价格并计算 SMA50/200、RSI14、MACD、成交量信号。

data.news.description: Fetches recent company news from FMP API.

data.peers.description: Combines EBITDA and EV/EBITDA for a list of peer tickers.

data.volume.description: Fetches historical trading volume data using yfinance.

finance.peer-forecast.description: Projects EBITDA for future years based on average historical YoY growth.

finance.historical.description: Extracts and combines historical financial metrics from FMP API data.

finance.forecast.description: Appends growth rates and forecasts to the historical metrics DataFrame.

news.enhanced.description: 增强版公司新闻获取函数

text.section.description: Generates a specific text section for the equity report using OpenAI Chat API.

chart.revenue-ebitda.description: 生成 Revenue & EBITDA 组合图表（柱状图 + 折线图）

chart.ev-ebitda-peer.description: 生成 EV/EBITDA 同行对比图表（分组柱状图或折线图）

chart.eps-pe.description: 生成 EPS × PE 双折线趋势图

chart.margin-trend.description: 生成利润率趋势图（多条折线）

chart.stock-price.description: 生成股价走势图（含移动平均线）

chart.time-series.description: 生成时序分析图（多指标对比）

chart.sensitivity-heatmap.description: 生成敏感性分析热力图

chart.quarterly-comparison.description: 生成季度财务对比图（同比/环比）

chart.cash-flow.description: 生成现金流分析图（堆叠柱状图）

chart.enhanced-ltm-ebitda-margin.description: 生成LTM EBITDA利润率图表（滚动12个月）

chart.enhanced-relative-performance.description: 生成相对表现图表（对比基准指数）

chart.enhanced-ev-ebitda-band.description: 生成EV/EBITDA估值区间图表（含均值和标准差）

chart.enhanced-p-fcf-band.description: 生成P/FCF估值区间图表（含均值和标准差）

chart.enhanced-eps-pe.description: 生成EPS × PE双折线趋势图

valuation.ev-ebitda.description: Original simplified valuation model; caller must supply values in consistent units.

valuation.dcf.description: Original simplified valuation model; caller must supply values in consistent units.

valuation.peer.description: Original simplified valuation model; caller must supply values in consistent units.

valuation.combined.description: Original simplified valuation model; caller must supply values in consistent units.

sensitivity.analyze.description: Original scenario sensitivity; confidence intervals are heuristic, not calibrated probabilities.

catalyst.analyze.description: Rule-based catalyst extraction from caller-supplied news.

news.process.description: Rule-based news categorization and importance scores from caller-supplied news.

sentiment.snapshot.description: Optional Adanos retail activity snapshot; explicit config required.

report.html.description: Render original professional HTML from complete supplied report data.

report.pdf.description: Render original professional PDF from complete supplied report data.

pipeline.full.description: Validated financial data -> forecasts -> valuation -> sensitivity/catalysts -> charts -> text -> HTML/PDF. Omitted financial_data needs allow-network; generate_text needs both network/model flags.
